body:
Found by the #624 rebuild in #653.

`Potassium dibasic phosphate trihydrate` previously carried `CHEBI:131527` / CAS `7758-11-4`. The record behind that identifier is the **anhydrous** salt:

```
data/ingredients/mapped/K2hpo4.yaml
  identifier: CHEBI:131527
  preferred_term: K2HPO4
```

So a trihydrate was taking an anhydrous identity, which MAPPING_SEMANTICS §3 refuses. The rebuild drops the match and the row is now `UNMAPPED` — correct, but it leaves the substance with no record at all, where the sodium-glutamate case at least has one to route to.

**Fix:** mint the trihydrate, per §3 — a form-specific ontology term if one exists, otherwise the registry pattern (`cas:` or `kgmicrobe.compound:`) with an asymmetric `skos:narrowMatch` to `CHEBI:131527` as the nearest parent, and both SSSOM rows per Rule B1.

Likely belongs to the #459 hydrate cohort (199 hydrate records / 173 formula-as-label records, overlapping by 95) rather than being worked alone; filing it separately so the specific name is not lost inside that cohort.

Not a blocker for #653.

Observed during the full current-owner Step 7d review for #901 at main `467aa319a06ef992035f509f66fe251082b44ae1`. These are proposed corrections or explicit deferrals before source writes; structural validation is not scientific approval. Exact owner preimages, primary-source capture hashes and full rubrics are prepared under `reports/step7d_mapping_901_20261103/` for the implementation PR.

The proposed `kgmicrobe.compound:k2hpo4_x_3_h2o` → `cas:16788-57-1` promotion would create two live owners of the same primary identifier. The complete K2HPO4 owner is therefore dropped from this batch; no grade-only change or partial chemistry edit is applied.

| Current owner | Primary identity | Current membership edges | Source distinction |
|---|---|---:|---|
| [`K2hpo4_X_3_H2o`](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/467aa319a06ef992035f509f66fe251082b44ae1/data/ingredients/mapped/K2hpo4_X_3_H2o.yaml) | `kgmicrobe.compound:k2hpo4_x_3_h2o` | 201 | MediaDive formula label `K2HPO4 x 3 H2O`; raw registry metadata give the dry salt. |
| [`Potassium_Phosphate_Dibasic_Trihydrate`](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/467aa319a06ef992035f509f66fe251082b44ae1/data/ingredients/mapped/Potassium_Phosphate_Dibasic_Trihydrate.yaml) | `cas:16788-57-1` | 3 | Existing CultureBotHT potassium phosphate dibasic trihydrate owner, with its own import history and occurrence context. |

[Primary Supelco 105099](https://www.sigmaaldrich.com/US/en/product/mm/105099) supports CAS 16788-57-1 for K2HPO4·3H2O, and [PubChem CID 16217523](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/cid/16217523/JSON) corroborates the three-water form. Those sources establish a candidate substance, not permission to merge the two source owners or transfer their recipes. The conflicting owner SHA256 is `c4fb96e92fd3ccbe4aa107fea350c8444633f992cf4758b5f21a6f86c804bc14`.

Options are (a) establish whether the two source contexts denote the same material and prepare a separately authorized identity/ownership reconciliation, or (b) document a source-form distinction or error that justifies retaining distinct owners. Recommendation: preserve both records, both identifiers and all 204 existing membership edges unchanged while recovering source-specific evidence. No owner merge, automatic occurrence transfer or silent alternate namespace is authorized.

Existing #656 is the same substance/ownership follow-up. Its claim that the trihydrate has no record is now contradicted by the existing CAS owner. Update #656 with this collision instead of minting another owner. #459 and #901 remain umbrellas. Closure requires a documented source/ownership decision and a separately reviewed reference-preserving implementation; this Step 7d deferral does not close the issue.
